fields.notes: OCP has a dedicated test signal group (scan, JTAG IEEE 1149.1, clock control) in addition to the protocol-level response/error qualifiers and per-thread busy observability. This makes DFT access part of the OCP socket itself rather than a purely chip-level concern.

in_band_test_facilities.name: Scan signals
in_band_test_facilities.purpose: Scanctrl/Scanin/Scanout drive the scan chains for manufacturing DFT — part of the OCP test signal group.

in_band_test_facilities.name: JTAG (IEEE 1149.1)
in_band_test_facilities.purpose: TCK/TMS/TDI/TDO/TRST_N boundary scan in the OCP test signal group.

in_band_test_facilities.name: Clock control
in_band_test_facilities.purpose: ClkByp/TestClk bypass/override the functional clock for at-speed test.

in_band_test_facilities.name: SResp / MError / SError
in_band_test_facilities.purpose: Response and error qualifiers report transfer/data faults.

in_band_test_facilities.name: Info side-channels
in_band_test_facilities.purpose: MDataInfo/SDataInfo can carry parity for data integrity.

out_of_band_test_facilities: OCP protocol checkers / BFMs in simulation.
JTAG (IEEE 1149.1) boundary scan via the test signal group.
